recommended_refinements.publication: Refine this existing master package; do not create another issue.

final_notes: No unrepresented UI feature requires a new master work package.
The refinements identify explicit task or acceptance text that should be incorporated or deliberately dispositioned before claiming exhaustive UI coverage.
Optional typography, calendar presets, export formats and cohort thresholds are revisable product decisions, not missing user permission for planning.
Raw Opus output is preserved unmodified. The reviewed concept and final master decisions override its unsupported acceptance and attribution examples.
